must_contain: Linking a record in M2 means linking a care context to the patient's ABHA address, which needs a link token for that patient.

The HIP first generates the link token, then calls POST /api/hiecm/hip/v3/link/carecontext with that token in the X-LINK-TOKEN header (header names are case-insensitive, and some pages write X-Link-Token).
notes: A real question from the live Ask AI panel that failed there, kept in the reader's exact words. It is ambiguous: the good answer reads it as HIP initiated care context linking with a link token. The Catalogue also holds hiecm.endpoint.m2-get-all-link-records ('GET All Link records'), but that is a PHR app read ('A PHR app calls this to list every care context linked'), not what an HIP integrator on M2 is building, so it is not expected. Source lines: catalogue/hiecm/flows/m2-link-care-context.md, title 'Link a care context to a patient's ABHA'; 'The HIP generates a linking token using the patient's ABHA address'; 'the patient's care context is linked to the ABHA Address'; step 5 'Your system calls `POST /api/hiecm/hip/v3/link/carecontext` with the gateway access token, the link token in `X-Link-Token`'. Review: header casing differs across atoms; either spelling is correct.
